items.heading: Engineers Already Think in Terms
items.text: Engineers already think in terms of trade-offs, edge cases, and constraints, the same muscles a PM uses to decide what to build and what to skip. Optimizing an algorithm and prioritizing a roadmap draw on the same analytical instinct: break a big problem into smaller testable pieces, then decide what matters most under real constraints.

items.heading: Every Version of "How
items.text: Every version of "how to become a PM" you will read online eventually reduces to two real doors. Pick based on what you actually have access to right now, not on which one sounds more impressive.
